name: B10-0292/2026 (PPE) – Political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It calls for the release of three named prisoners held in Nicaragua: Carlos Brenes, Salvadora Martínez and Brooklyn Rivera, who died in custody. It asks Nicaragua to free all political prisoners, allow family and lawyer visits, and investigate Rivera's death. It also asks the European Union to widen sanctions and suspend its trade agreement with Nicaragua.

- The European Union is asked to widen sanctions and suspend its trade agreement with Nicaragua.
- The demands concern Nicaragua's government, its prisoners and their families.
- The Parliament asks for an international investigation into Brooklyn Rivera's death.
